prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for the VOICES floating memory-mask companion. Image 1 is the exact NEW MODEL to animate: preserve its unique silhouette, carved face, colors, ornaments, feathers and identity. Images 2 and 3 are the EXISTING PLAYER 1 and PLAYER 2 ANIMATION ATLASES: follow their deliberate pixel-art finish, expressive faces, timing phases and 4-column / 8-row layout, but do NOT replace image 1's model with them. Crisp stepped pixel clusters and dark outlines, carved wood facets, no smoothing or 3D.
Create exactly FOUR equal COLUMNS by EIGHT equal ROWS = 32 complete independent sprites, portrait 1:2 canvas. Stable centered registration and scale, full silhouette including all feathers/earrings/leaves visible with >=12% clear transparent padding INSIDE EVERY cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Each row has the following actual DRAWN FACIAL CHANGES, not merely moving/scaling a static portrait:
Row 1 FRONT idle blink: eyes open, half closed, completely closed lids, reopening.
Row 2 LEFT three-quarter turn: open, half closed, closed, reopening; draw changed face perspective.
Row 3 RIGHT three-quarter turn: open, half closed, closed, reopening; opposite face perspective.
Row 4 FRONT investigation activation: neutral, brighter jewel and eyes, brightest restrained inner eye/jewel glow, settle. No surrounding glow cloud.
Row 5 FRONT speaking: lips apart, small open mouth, rounded O mouth, nearly closed. Distinct mouth shapes.
Row 6 FRONT curious: eyebrow raised, gaze left, gaze right, relaxed.
Row 7 FRONT surprised: eyes widen, small O mouth, recovery, settle.
Row 8 FRONT happy: gentle smile, bigger smile, happy closed eyes, relaxed smile.
Genuine transparent RGBA background, alpha=0 between all sprites and at cell corners. Preserve opaque dark eye sockets/interior carved details. No backdrop, checkerboard, tiles, shadows, grid lines, labels, words, numbers, watermark or scene. Only this ONE mask design repeated with expressive drawn variations. Fictional fantasy masks, no specific real ceremonial attribution.

MODEL: Caveira — an ivory painted wooden SKULL fantasy mask, five tall red feathers forming a crest, vertical red forehead stripe, red dot markings, dark deep eye sockets, small black triangular nose cavity, individually carved ivory teeth, long orange/brown pointed wooden chin, gold spiral ear hoops and dangling small red/gold/turquoise bead earrings. Keep the skull recognizable and friendly in expressive poses. Animate the sockets with carved ivory eyelids that lower/close/reopen over the dark recesses; eyebrows lift/widen the socket shapes for curiosity and surprise; the jaw and tooth rows articulate apart for speaking and a rounded O opening, and lift into a friendly smile for happy. During investigation activation only, a restrained amber inner light appears inside sockets. Preserve teeth, crest, chin and earrings across all 32 frames. No human skin, no gore.
CRITICAL: keep all 32 frames and rows evenly spaced, row 1 frame 3 and row 8 frame 3 have clearly closed skull eyelids; row 5 must have visible jaw/tooth articulation, not four identical skulls.
